import numpy as np
from statsmodels.tsa.stattools import acf

# Create data with NaNs: 200 observations followed by 200 NaNs
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
x_dropped = rng.standard_normal(200)
x = np.concatenate([x_dropped, np.full(200, np.nan)])

# Call acf with missing='drop'
res = acf(x, nlags=40, qstat=True, alpha=0.05, missing='drop', fft=False)

# res[0] = autocorrelations
# res[1] = confint (confidence intervals)
# res[2] = qstat (q-statistics)

# Record confint half-width at lag 1: (upper - lower) / 2
confint_halfwidth_lag1 = (res[1][1, 1] - res[1][1, 0]) / 2.0
probe('confint_halfwidth_lag1', confint_halfwidth_lag1)

# Record qstat at lag 1 (first q-statistic)
qstat_lag1 = res[2][0]
probe('qstat_lag1', qstat_lag1)
